subject: HarborTrust - Operational Resilience & FFIEC-style Controls questionnaire
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@harbortrust.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTrust Audit Team <audit@harbortrust.com>
Date: 2026-08-27 09:15 -0400
Subject: Operational resilience questionnaire - initial delivery

Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is HarborTrust's operational resilience and FFIEC-style controls questionnaire that we need completed as part of our vendor third-party resilience review (we're running this across the payments/workflow infrastructure). Can you confirm Redwood Inference can provide:

- A controls mapping showing how your platform meets the FFIEC operational resiliency elements (BC/DR, change control, access management, monitoring).
- Copies or summaries of recent attestation artifacts (SOC 2 Type II summary, penetration test high-level findings).
- Evidence of logging/retention (sample logs), incident response runbook excerpt, and RTO/RPO expectations for hosted vs. private deployments.
- A point of contact for evidence delivery and a proposed timeline — our target is to close vendor reviews by 2026-09-07.

I attached our questionnaire PDF and marked sections where we'd expect supporting artifacts. If you need more time, let me know.

Appreciate it —
Elena Ruiz
VP, Third-Party Risk Management
HarborTrust Bank

Attachment: HarborTrust_RFI_Questions.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: HarborTrust Audit Team <audit@harbortrust.com>
Date: 2026-08-27 11:02 -0400
Subject: Re: Operational resilience questionnaire - initial delivery

Elena —

Thanks for sending this over and for the timeline. We can absolutely support this review. High-level plan:

1) Deliver a controls mapping (FFIEC-style) cross-referenced to our public docs and internal artifacts — by 2026-09-01.
2) Provide a SOC 2 Type II summary + redacted pen test summary and runbook excerpts by 2026-09-01.
3) Provide sample logs (redacted) and an explanation of retention/segmentation for hosted vs. private deployments.

I'll coordinate with our security and compliance team for evidence and will upload items to a secure share. If HarborTrust prefers a dedicated NDA-backed transfer, we can use the DocuSign/secure link you prefer.

Point of contact here is myself (marcus.lin@redwood.com). I'll loop in our Compliance lead for evidence handling.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_Control_Mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

- Controls mapping (FFIEC-style): map to our features for hosted, dedicated, private (owner: ?; ETA 2026-08-31)
- SOC 2 Type II summary and pen-test redacted report: (owner: Neha?; ETA 2026-09-01)

Subject: Re: FW: HarborTrust - Operational resilience questionnaire — evidence owners and timeline

Marcus / team —

I can own the SOC2/pen-test artifacts. Quick notes on evidence and redaction:

- SOC 2: we'll provide the SOC 2 Type II summary (one-page cover + control scope) and a redacted copy of the full report. Redaction will remove customer names, IP addresses, and any internal ticket IDs.
- Pen test: provide the executive summary and a redacted findings table; we will not share raw exploit artifacts.
- Logs: sample access logs can be redacted (hashing user ids) and time-windowed. I'll coordinate with infra to pull a 24-hour sample that demonstrates authentication and key rotation events.

I estimate having the SOC2 summary and pen-test executive summary ready by 2026-09-01 EOD. Sample logs and retention policy statements I can have by 2026-08-31.

For transfer: suggest a secure SFTP/box link or HarborTrust's preferred secure upload. I'll also draft a short attestation document describing redaction steps.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Elena —

Attached is Redwood Inference's response package for HarborTrust's operational resilience / FFIEC-style questionnaire. Summary of what we've included below. If you'd like a short walkthrough call, we can schedule a 30-minute review next week.

Included items (attachments):
- RI_Control_Mapping_v1.xlsx — Controls mapping across hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments (tabbed by domain: Access Management, Change Control, Monitoring, BC/DR).
- SOC2_report_summary.pdf — One-page SOC 2 Type II summary and scope; full report redacted per our policy.
- DR_Runbook_Excerpt.pdf — Runbook excerpts showing RTO/RPO by deployment class and escalation matrix.
- access_logs_sample.csv — 24-hour sample access logs (PII redacted/hash).
- HarborTrust_RFI_Questions_filled.pdf — Our question-by-question answers (bound references to the mapping and artifacts above).

We have also uploaded the artifacts to a secure folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExampleLink (HarborTrust access granted to audit@harbortrust.com).

Notes and caveats:
- Penetration test: attached is the executive summary and findings table only. We do not share raw exploit code or internal ticket content.
- Incident history: we included a high-level incident summary for the last 24 months; details are available under NDA if required.
- For private/on-prem deployments, customers control key rotation and network egress policies; our mapping indicates which controls are customer-managed vs. Redwood-managed.

Please confirm receipt and whether HarborTrust wants any additional artifacts or a secure video walkthrough. Our target is to close this cycle by 2026-09-07; if HarborTrust needs more time, let us know.

Thanks —

Redwood Inference
